nTop

nTop

nTop uses implicit modelling and field-driven design for complex, high-performance engineered geometry.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Generate a lattice region

Use current feature dimensions, datums and design intent. In the intended nTop preview, generate a lattice region; the visible result is the revised solid and its driving constraints. Review interfaces, retained references and manufacturable intent before accepting or exporting it.

Drive geometry with a field

Start from the selected part or assembly revision. In the intended nTop preview, drive geometry with a field; the visible result is an updated assembly state with affected relationships highlighted. Review fit, motion, access and clearance before accepting or exporting it.

Prepare an export for validation

Begin with the reviewed model and release properties. In the intended nTop preview, prepare an export for validation; the visible result is a drawing, bill of materials or model definition tied to that revision. Review dimensions, revision identity and downstream completeness before accepting or exporting it.
